description: Arcana Suite (Divination Suite) shell: one home for the divination modules. Home screen with one tile per module (2 live: Astrology App, Arcana; 9 Coming soon with their plan), a shared profile entered once (name, birth date, time, place) with up to 100 saved charts on-device, and shared settings (Classical / Modern, Tropical / Sidereal, house system; Red Letters and canon filters for Bible only). Opens each live module's own index.html by path, never a copy. Single-page web app; no build step, no dependencies.
name: Arcana Suite
requires: the module folders next to it: ../astrology-app/ and ../arcana-app/ in a release, ../mini-apps/<app>/ in the vault
